## Architecture change

Describe the architecture change and the business outcome it supports.

## Objects changed

- [ ] Business / capability / process
- [ ] Application / integration / data
- [ ] Technology / platform
- [ ] Motivation / requirement / constraint
- [ ] Implementation / transition
- [ ] Governance rule or view

## Ownership and review

Who owns the affected service, process, application, data, or platform?

## Expected impact

List important downstream processes, applications, data objects, technology services, controls, or views that may be affected.

## Validation

- [ ] `eaops validate .` passes
- [ ] Impact has been reviewed
- [ ] New objects have owner and description metadata
- [ ] Critical processes remain supported by a Serving relationship
- [ ] Data objects have classification metadata

## Decision

Explain why this is the preferred architecture change and note any known trade-offs.
